summary: Query the On the Cheap network (charlotteonthecheap.com, milehighonthecheap.com and ~12 sister city sites) from the shell with curl and jq — daily local event listings with times/prices/venues, plus searchable articles on free and cheap things to do. Use when the user wants local event or deal data and the onthecheap MCP server is not available.
